set.body: PLS Neuro public-API review found Query.scala exactOne/radiusOne rounds Double to Long then narrows to Int; finite transformed coordinate 4294967296 wraps to zero and can report a label in voxel zero. Reproduce through exactEither using identity affine and one labelled voxel; require checked refusal or honest no-label for huge finite values, nonfinite coordinates, and overflow-prone radius offsets. Consumer bd-01M2B711JWZZDY7BT7381EBDKQ has a fail-closed Int-margin guard. Native shared JVM+JS regression required; do not silently wrap.
set.title: Atlas exact and radius queries must reject overflowing voxel coordinates
